nodes.name: Get existing resources
nodes.notes: Including dead ones. A resource that 404'd last month must not be rediscovered and proposed back in as new.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.notes: Tavily because it returns clean text per result rather than HTML to scrape. Swap for Brave or SerpAPI by changing this one node — nothing downstream knows which engine answered. The key lives in an n8n Header Auth credential (Authorization / Bearer tvly-...), never in this file.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: "You classify study resources for IT certifications. You are strict: most search results are not worth a learner's time. Judge only from the title, url and snippet given. Never invent a url — copy it exactly from the candidate. If nothing is genuinely good, return an empty results array. An empty array is a correct and common answer." }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: 'Certification: ' + $json.name + ' (' + $json.short_name + ') by ' + $json.provider + '

Candidates:
' + $json.candidates.map((c, i) => (i+1) + '. ' + c.title + '
   ' + c.url + '
   ' + c.snippet).join('

') + '

Return the ones an actual learner should use.' }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', maxOutputTokens: 4096, responseSchema: { type: 'OBJECT', properties: { results: { type: 'ARRAY', items: { type: 'OBJECT', properties: { url: { type: 'STRING' }, title: { type: 'STRING' }, provider: { type: 'STRING' }, type: { type: 'STRING', enum: ['course', 'documentation', 'video', 'practice-exam', 'book'] }, free: { type: 'BOOLEAN' }, duration: { type: 'STRING' }, ai_reason: { type: 'STRING' }, confidence: { type: 'NUMBER' } }, required: ['url', 'title', 'provider', 'type', 'free', 'duration', 'ai_reason', 'confidence'], propertyOrdering: ['url', 'title', 'provider', 'type', 'free', 'duration', 'ai_reason', 'confidence'] } } }, required: ['results'] } } }) }}

nodes.name: Rank and classify
nodes.notes: Gemini via generateContent. responseSchema + responseMimeType application/json constrain the reply so there is nothing to regex — candidates[0].content.parts[0].text is a JSON string matching {results:[...]}. free/duration are still the model guess, which is why this proposes rather than writes. Model gemini-3.1-flash-lite (free tier); swap the model name in the url for a stronger flash if you want a better judge. Key lives in a Header Auth credential (header name x-goog-api-key) — use a SEPARATE Gemini key/project from the advisor so a weekly sweep cannot spend the advisor's daily quota. If a run returns empty text, raise maxOutputTokens (thinking models can spend the budget before emitting).

nodes.name: Propose it
nodes.notes: Writes to the review queue, never to certification_resources. Nothing here reaches a user until someone reads the row and inserts it themselves. status defaults to 'open'.
